description: A week of step counts where clicking a bar selects it, dims the others and updates the header.
overview: A week of step counts where one bar is selected at a time: the chosen day stays solid, the rest dim, and the header shows its value. Use it when a bar chart doubles as a picker for the detail shown above it.
usage: Replace `chartData` with your own days and values, and rename `steps` in the data, the `Bar` and `chartConfig`. Set the initially selected bar through the `selected` state, and change the unit text and number format in the header. Lower or raise the opacity of the dimmed bars to tune the contrast.
notes: Keyboard users move between bars with the arrow keys and select with Return or Space, and the header value is announced through a live region. There is no tooltip; the header is the only readout.
